headline: IMF chief urges US and wealthy nations to rein in debt to ease global economic pressure - myMotherLode.com
summary: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said the US and other wealthy nations need to urgently tackle mounting global debt. High debt is weighing on low-income countries and straining the global financial system.
why: The IMF is the global lender that monitors sovereign debt and macroeconomic stability across member countries.
